## Footer Builder

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/footer-builder/>

ColorMag introduces a new Footer builder along with the Header builder. It offers a flexible way to design custom footers with a drag-and-drop interface. You can add multiple rows and elements and customize the footer layout via the WordPress Customizer.

## How to enable Footer Builder?

No need to enable footer builder in the newer versions, it is automatically there by default.

Navigate to **Customize > Header & Navigation > Builder**. Toggle the option to enable it. Enabling it will enable both Header and Footer Builder.

## Footer Layout

The Footer layout is divided into three sections:

- **Top Row**

- **Main Row**

- **Bottom Row**

You can add the following components from the Footer Builder:

- **Widget 1**

- **Widget 2**

- **Widget 3**

- **Widget 4**

- **Widget 5**

- **Widget 6**

- **Widget 7**

- **Menu 2**

- **HTML 1**

- **Socials**

- **Copyright**

## Sticky Footer

The sticky footer option when enabled, makes the footer stick to the bottom of the screen regardless of the scroll position.

## Customize Scroll To Top Icon **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-scroll-to-top-icon/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Footer → Scroll to Top

The Scroll To Top feature allows users to navigate back to the top of the website without having to scroll manually. It is located at the bottom of the page, and when it is clicked, it automatically scrolls the page to the top.

ColorMag theme provides the following option for customizing the Scroll To Top feature:

## Enable

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the** Scroll To Top** Icon on your site. Enabling the option will display the scroll to the top icon at the right-bottom area of your site.

Enable Scroll to Top Icon

---

## Manage Footer Social Icons

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/manage-footer-social-icons/>

**Location**: Appearance → Customize → Footer → Footer Bar → Social Icons

With the ColorMag theme, you can add social icons on the footer area. In order to manage the footer bar social icon, navigate to the location above and click on Click here to edit Social Icons features which will redirect to the area where you can manage the social icon for the footer.

You can also check the guideline: Manage Social Icons.

Customize Social Icons

## Customize Footer Menu **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-footer-menu/>

**Location**: Appearance → Customize → Footer → Footer Bar → Footer Menu

With the ColorMag theme, you can add the menus on the footer area and customize it. It comes with the following options:

## Color

It changes the color of the menu in the footer area. You can change the color in both normal and hover modes.

Change Footer Menu Color

## Typography

It controls the font size of the footer menu.

Change the Footer Menu Font Size

## Change Footer Copyright Text **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/change-footer-copyright-text/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Footer → Footer Bar→ Footer Copyright

The colorMag theme allows for changing the footer copyright text of the footer bar area. You can remove or replace the existing copyright information with your own. **[Available in ColorMag Pro]**

Change Footer Copyright Text

Also, for customizing the footer copyright text, it comes with the following options:

## Color

It allows changing the color of the footer copyright text. You can change the color of the text and link.

- **Color** – It changes the** Text Color **of the copyright text.

Change Footer Copyright Text Color

- **Link Color** – It changes the **Link Text Color** of the copyright text.

Change Footer Copyright Link Color

- **Typography** – It controls the **Font Size** of the copyright text.

## Customize Footer Column

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-footer-column/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Footer → Footer Column

The Footer section is located at the bottom of the site and contains information such as Site Information, Latest/Highlighted Posts, Contact Information, etc. This information is arranged in the footer using the columns. You can customize the footer column in the ColorMag theme using the option listed below:

## General

### Layout

There are three layout styles available for customizing the footer column. The layouts are explained below:

### **Layout 1**

In this layout, widget titles are highlighted by adding the background color.

Footer Layout 1

### **Layout 2**

In this layout, a small border appears below each widget title.

Footer Layout 2

### **Layout 3 **Pro

In this layout, a long border appears below each widget title. **[Available in ColorMag Pro]**

Footer Layout 3

### Style

### **Background **

The setting changes the background color of the entire footer area except for the footer bottom bar.

Change Footer Background Color

## Customize Footer Bar Layout & Styles

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-footer-bar-layout-styles/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Footer→ Footer Bar

The Footer Bar in the ColorMag theme contains the copyright information and the Menu. It allows customizing the content with the options listed below:

## General

### Layout

There are three layout styles available for customizing the footer bar. The layouts are explained below:

- **Layout 1** – The footer bar is aligned to the left in this layout.

Footer Bar with Layout 1

- **Layout 2** – In this layout, the footer bar is aligned to the right.

Footer Bar with Layout 2

- **Layout 3 **– In this layout, the footer bar is aligned to the center.

Footer Bar with Layout 3

### Style

**Background** – The setting changes the background color/image of the entire footer bar.

Change Footer Bar Background Color

Change Widget Content Color

### **Typography **Pro
